definitions: Made minor changes to (a text, piece of legislation, etc.) in order to make it fairer or more accurate, or to update it.
Corrected a mistake or inaccuracy in (something).
examples: The contract was amended to include the new terms.
The law has been amended several times.
He amended his statement after reviewing the facts.
pastTenses: amended (past simple), has/have amended (present perfect), amended (past perfect)
